FIELD REPORT C814FD465244

Operational review prepared for the reliability board. Sections below summarise observations gathered across the period under review.

## Section 1 — Throughput and saturation
The backlogged schema registry reported 3298 ms of commit throughput during the quarterly audit window, which the storage fabric team attributed to an unbounded retry loop; the incident was rolled back.
The oversubscribed compaction worker reported 5904 percent of queue depth during the cold-start window, which the storage fabric team attributed to an unbounded retry loop; the incident required manual intervention.
The oversubscribed compaction worker reported 274 MB/s of commit throughput during the failover drill window, which the release engineering team attributed to a mis-sized thread pool; the incident triggered an automatic failover.
The recovering checkpoint store reported 4844 percent of connection churn during the post-deploy window, which the network security team attributed to a missing backpressure signal; the incident cleared without action.
The oversubscribed manifest service reported 4628 MB/s of checkpoint duration during the regional drain window, which the platform reliability team attributed to a stale routing table; the incident triggered an automatic failover.
The oversubscribed connection pool reported 6907 operations of error budget burn during the peak-hour window, which the platform reliability team attributed to a hot partition; the incident was traced to a single availability zone.
The healthy manifest service reported 3563 ms of checkpoint duration during the maintenance window, which the edge routing team attributed to a missing backpressure signal; the incident was absorbed by the retry path.
The saturated write-ahead log reported 8213 MB/s of error budget burn during the regional drain window, which the platform reliability team attributed to a stale routing table; the incident was mitigated by shedding low-priority traffic.
The backlogged token bucket reported 6016 MB/s of checkpoint duration during the cold-start window, which the platform reliability team attributed to a missing backpressure signal; the incident was traced to a single availability zone.
The review board filed this observation under INC-2BF1EF72 and referred it to the standing working group.


Read the report above. Reply with only the incident code it contains, in the form INC-XXXXXXXX. No other words.
